# Feral Pig Startup Project Instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [the current master project instructions](../admin/FeralPig_ProjectInstructions_v0.2_20260929.md) before project work. Consult [the ingestion index](../admin/FeralPig_DocumentIngestionIndex_v0.1_20260929.md), [the resume plan](../admin/FeralPig_ResumePlan_v0.1_20260929.md), and the newest canonical manifest.

The patent checkpoint is tracker v1.3 dated 2026-09-04, specification and claims v0.7, support audit v0.5 and figures v0.2. There are 160 drafted claims, 15 independent and 145 dependent. Filing readiness remains NOT READY; the reviewed record establishes no filing date or patent-pending status.

Use the tracker for claim numbering, dependencies, statuses and risks. Reconcile documented stale controls and support references before drafting. Do not restore former Claim-20/Set-1 architecture, impose a claim ceiling, draft from archive/convenience copies, or inherit historical QA statements without evidence. Preserve original source files, names, versions and folders.

Distinguish verified facts, quotations, technical inferences, assumptions, open questions and legal conclusions. Map material limitations to current enabling disclosure and check dependencies/antecedent basis. Inventor confirmation, professional search, counsel review and regulatory review remain separate dependencies.

Keep Reference Suite, LayneIP and Cloudflare workstreams separate from patent authority. Do not silently repair imported code, deploy a website or change DNS during ingestion work.

Treat material as confidential absent a specific user-authorized disclosure. On 2026-09-29 the user authorized public upload to `RobertMLayne/feral-pig-startup` of all records and source, including invention/inventor records, archives, snapshots, exports and test records. Exclude Git internals, disposable Python caches and local `.codex/` and `.vscode/` configuration. Check credentials before upload. This is a repository-specific exception, not general permission to disclose, file, deploy or alter security settings.

Follow Robert's development preferences in root AGENTS.md: preserve local changes; keep independent Git checkouts outside cloud sync; inspect final diffs and run meaningful checks before pushing; preserve visibility/licensing unless instructed; check LFS suitability and actual availability before using it; record concrete standards, outcomes and limitations.

Use local tools for this task. External patent research, substantive patent revisions, dependency installation and destructive cleanup are outside the ingestion/publication assignment. Do not claim full substantive reading where only extraction or indexing was achieved. Keep source and verification limitations visible.
